head: Amazon's Android-based Alexa Tablets get their first Black Friday prices
dek: Amazon's Alexa Tablet 8, 11 and 12 Pro, which run Android with the Google Play Store instead of Fire OS, are on sale on Amazon ahead of Black Friday: $149.99 instead of $229.99 for the 8 and $219.99 instead of $329.99 for the 11, according to Android Central.
